title: Live GitHub barrier-backed PIN race · 5 workers v3
mission: Run one fresh real-GitHub five-worker contention canary on a clean fixed G000001 generation using the binding timing-only contention barrier. Five genuinely distinct /wc workers register before the v3 deadline; a no-authority RELEASE then sends all released entrants to the same deterministic G000001 portfolio PIN. Exactly one PIN/claim winner and four genuine loser collision receipts must result. Never manufacture entrants/collisions, never create G000002+ for this fixture, and do not promote production /w or product authority.
definition_of_done: Five distinct /wc worker_ids have append-only entrant receipts under live-pin-barrier-race5-v3 before deadline.

Exactly one RELEASE.json exists and lists exactly the canonical five-member release cohort: the lexicographic first five distinct valid entrant worker_ids; overfull, unsorted or unknown-entrant RELEASE documents are invalid.
No portfolio PIN attempt exists before valid RELEASE; timeout instead records pin_attempted=false and remains a non-pass bounded outcome.
After RELEASE exactly one valid G000001 portfolio PIN winner and one matching authoritative claim exist for this job.
Exactly four distinct generation-1 prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1 loser receipts exist; no loser creates an authoritative execution claim and each records next_action=REENTER_ALLOCATION.
The fixed-generation recovery policy keeps the fixture out of ordinary G+1 recovery and resolves fixed_generation_attention only when the four-collision acceptance threshold is durably satisfied.
Ordinary jobs remain direct-to-PIN and no Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is promoted.

static_contract_revision.reason: Align fixture acceptance with binding exact release-cohort membership semantics; only released cohort members race G000001.
